$sources: The species: Malva moschata L., musk mallow: a perennial 30-80 cm, the stem leaves deeply palmately divided; flowers 3-6 cm, pale pink (rarely white), the five petals notched, flowering July to August (C. Stace, New Flora of the British Isles, 4th ed., Cambridge 2019, Malvaceae).
The plants at the Hall of Light's plotted points (the as-built meadow, HallOfLightPlanting.swift and nature.py:922-930), heights 0.4-0.9.
name: Malva moschata
note: Pink, as the sheet colours it (0xD9A5A0); its first flowers at the end of June. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
